"CREATE A FULLY PLAYABLE 3D MOBILE FOOTBALL GAME INSPIRED BY EA SPORTS FC MOBILE.

GAME TITLE: FOOTBALL MOBILE 2026.

IMPORTANT:
This game is designed specifically for touchscreen phones. It must have real 3D gameplay, not a 2D menu or a static demonstration.

1. MAIN MENU

When the player enters the game, show:

- PLAY
- TEAM SELECTION
- TOURNAMENTS
- SETTINGS
- MY CLUB

2. TEAM SELECTION

Allow the player to choose one of these nine clubs:

- Real Madrid
- Paris Saint-Germain
- FC Barcelona
- Manchester City
- Manchester United
- Chelsea
- FCSB
- Rapid București
- Dinamo București

Display each club's official crest, team name, home kit and away kit.

After selecting a team, load its real squad, including:

- Real player names.
- Correct playing positions.
- Accurate player ratings.
- Realistic player faces using licensed assets or authorized likenesses.
- Correct shirt numbers.
- Correct club kits.

Use up-to-date squad information. Never invent players or create blank player models.

3. MOBILE TOUCH CONTROLS

Create a touchscreen control system inspired by FC Mobile.

LEFT SIDE:

- Virtual joystick for player movement.
- Smooth 360-degree movement.
- Responsive directional control.

RIGHT SIDE:

- SHOOT button.
- PASS button.
- THROUGH PASS button.
- SPRINT button.
- SKILL MOVES button.
- SWITCH PLAYER button.
- TACKLE button when defending.
- SLIDE TACKLE button.

SPRINT AND SKILL MOVES:

- Holding sprint makes the player run faster.
- Double tapping sprint performs a skill move.
- Add different skill moves depending on the player's skill rating.
- Allow skill moves to be assigned and customized in settings.
- Add combinations of swipes and button taps.
- Make the skill moves animated and realistic.

4. FOOTBALL GAMEPLAY

Create realistic 3D football gameplay:

- Eleven players per team.
- Realistic passing and shooting.
- Goalkeepers with animations.
- Ball physics.
- Player collisions.
- Fouls and free kicks.
- Penalties.
- Corners.
- Throw-ins.
- Offside.
- Yellow and red cards.
- Substitutions.
- Match timer.
- Scoreboard.

5. COMPETITIONS

Allow the player to enter different competitions with their selected club.

CLUB COMPETITIONS:

- UEFA Champions League.
- UEFA Europa League.
- UEFA Conference League.
- Premier League.
- La Liga.
- Ligue 1.
- Romanian SuperLiga.

Create realistic tournament formats, standings, fixtures, knockout stages and finals.

6. INTERNATIONAL COMPETITIONS

Create a separate national team selection mode.

Include:

- FIFA World Cup.
- UEFA European Championship.
- Copa América.

Allow players to select a national team and use its real squad.

7. STADIUMS

Create realistic 3D stadiums with:

- Crowds.
- Stadium lighting.
- Football pitches.
- Goals and nets.
- Stadium announcements.
- Crowd reactions.
- Day and night matches.

Include stadiums inspired by famous football grounds.

8. GRAPHICS

Use high-quality 3D graphics.
Create realistic football player models and faces.
Add realistic running, passing, shooting and celebration animations.
Make the kits and player appearances match their teams.

9. SETTINGS

Allow players to:

- Change control layouts.
- Adjust joystick sensitivity.
- Customize skill moves.
- Change camera angles.
- Adjust graphics quality.
- Change match duration.
- Adjust sound and music.

10. SAVING SYSTEM

Save:

- Selected club.
- Player progress.
- Tournament progress.
- Match results.
- Settings.
- Unlocked items.

11. IMPORTANT TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS

Optimize the game for Android touchscreen devices.
Make every button functional.
Implement actual playable football matches.
Use real 3D player models and animations.
Do not create fake controls or nonfunctional menus.

Build the game in playable stages if necessary, but prioritize fully working mobile controls and football gameplay.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build and deliver a playable 3D mobile football game titled “FOOTBALL MOBILE 2026.”

## Requirements
- Touch-first mobile controls with real 3D football gameplay.
- Main menu, club/team selection, competitions, settings, and club progress.
- Eleven-player matches, ball physics, passing, shooting, AI, goals, scoreboard, timer, and stadium presentation.
- Persistent saved team, settings, match history, competition, and progress.
- Reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a single-page Three.js web game in `index.html`.
- Used original stylized crests/kits and generic numbered 3D athlete models rather than fabricating current player identities or claiming licensed assets.
- Added an exhibition-style tournament flow rather than verified live rosters or official tournament data.
- Prioritized playable touchscreen functionality over a full licensed production feature set.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built the styled main menu and navigation screens.
- Added nine club selections with visual colors and team names.
- Added club and international competition menus.
- Added international national-team selection.
- Added settings for layout, sensitivity, skill move, camera, quality, duration, sound, and music.
- Added localStorage saving for team and match/settings progress.
- Built a Three.js pitch, goals, stadium seating, crowd dots, stadium lighting, and player/ball models.
- Built 11-player formations, active-player switching, joystick movement, passing, shooting, tackling, sprinting, and skill actions.
- Added basic AI, ball possession, goal detection, scoreboard, match timer, pause menu, kit switching, keyboard fallback, audio cues, and vibration cues.
- Added player shirt numbers and selected-player ground marker.
- Added generic national-team kit palettes.

### Active
- Game is implemented but has not been reported as browser-verified or visually inspected.
- Gameplay remains a simplified 3D exhibition-style implementation.

### Blocked
- Real licensed player likenesses, accurate names, ratings, shirt numbers, official kits, and live squad data require licensed assets/data and are not available locally.
- Full fouls, cards, substitutions, penalties, corners, throw-ins, offside, knockout tournaments, standings, and real broadcast production remain incomplete.

## Next Move
1. Run the game through a local server and inspect it in the browser.
2. Test the menu, team selection, match kickoff, joystick, passing, shooting, pause, restart, and save flows.
3. Fix any Three.js runtime, layout, or gameplay bugs found during browser verification.
4. Add fuller match rules and actual competition progression if real tournament behavior is required.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Complete current implementation.

## Important Context
- The project currently has no separate source/build directory; the implementation is in `index.html`.
- The build explicitly uses stylized generic athletes and does not claim to include real player names, licensed faces, accurate ratings, or official assets.
- A national-team selection mode exists, but its home team can use generic kits and the match is exhibition-style.
- Match completion updates local saved wins, draws, losses, goals, and latest result.

## Objective
- Deliver a playable 3D mobile football game titled “FOOTBALL MOBILE 2026.”

## Requirements
- Touch-first controls, 3D gameplay, match presentation, team and competition selection, settings, and club progress.
- Persist team, settings, match history, and progress locally; use reasonable assumptions without follow-up questions.
- Avoid implying licensed assets or accurate current rosters.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a single-page Three.js game in `index.html`, with original stylized teams and generic numbered athletes.
- Competition choices launch exhibition-style matches; full tournament progression and official licensing are not included.

## Work State
### Completed
- Main menu, team and competition selection, settings, local saving, 3D match, player/ball models, controls, AI, goals, scoreboard, pause, and match progress.
- Fixed JavaScript syntax and script-closure issues; extracted module passes `node --check`.
- Mobile Chromium interaction pass verified team/settings/nation selection, local persistence across reload, joystick and action controls, pause/resume, restart, and return to menu.
- Visual screenshots were captured; menu and match presentation appeared coherent.
- Confirmed browser 404 console message occurs, but no failed network requests or page errors were recorded during the latest pass.

### Active
- Identify the source of the remaining browser 404 and determine whether any final fixes are needed.
- Match completion/progress update was not verified end-to-end.

### Blocked
- Real licensed likenesses, official assets, and live squad data are unavailable.
- Full football rules and tournament progression remain outside the simplified exhibition implementation.

## Next Move
1. Identify the URL behind the browser’s 404 console message.
2. Verify match completion updates the club record and persists after reload.
3. Fix any concrete issues found and rerun syntax and browser checks.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: complete game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/mobile-match.png`: latest mobile gameplay screenshot.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Existing browser smoke tests use Playwright Core from `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/node_modules` with `/usr/bin/chromium`.
- Local server is available on port `3002`; an attempt to start a second server failed because the port was already in use.
- Latest mobile test confirmed persisted team selection (`Chelsea`), camera (`Action`), match duration (`2`), sound (`false`), and nation (`Argentina`); no page errors or failed requests.
